name: zovo-har-viewer
description: Open .har files from browser DevTools as a request table with a timing waterfall, filters, headers, cookies and bodies. Copy as cURL or fetch, export filtered requests and save a redacted copy without tokens or cookies. Offline.

harViewer.maxFileMB.description: Largest HAR file that is opened, in MB. A HAR is one JSON document, so the whole file is read into memory.

harViewer.slowRequestMs.description: A request that takes this many milliseconds or more counts as slow. The Slow filter and the summary use it.

harViewer.maxBodyKB.description: Largest request or response body shown in the details pane, in KB. Longer bodies are cut, and Copy still copies the full text.

harViewer.askForRating.description: Ask one time for a Marketplace rating after you have used HAR Viewer for a few days. You can answer "Later" or "Don't ask again". Nothing is sent anywhere.

harViewer.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Sponsor and More free viewers links in the status line of the viewer. The change shows in files you open next. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with HAR Viewer
walkthroughs.description: Read network captures from browser DevTools in VS Code, offline.

steps.title: Open a HAR file
steps.description:
Save a HAR from the Network tab of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, then click the .har file in the Explorer.
[Find a HAR file](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.har%22%5D)

media.altText: A HAR file in HAR Viewer with the request table, the timing waterfall and the details pane.

steps.title: Find slow and failed requests
steps.description: Filter by type, status, domain or text. The Slow and Failed buttons jump to the requests that need a look, and Export filtered writes them to a new HAR.

steps.title: Share a redacted copy
steps.description:
A banner warns when the file holds Authorization headers, cookies or tokens. Save a redacted copy before you attach a HAR to a ticket.
[Save a redacted copy](command:harViewer.redact)

scripts.package: npm run build && npx -y @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o dist/
